name: Analytic object
definition: Functions, transforms, measures, and formulas used in analytic number theory.

name: Positivity criterion
definition: A criterion phrased as positivity or nonnegativity of a form, sequence, kernel, or matrix.

name: Spectral framework
definition: An operator, trace formula, or spectral model used to organize RH-adjacent questions.

name: Arithmetic geometry
definition: Geometric and cohomological structures carrying arithmetic information.

name: TFPT compiler structure
definition: A project-internal finite structure or bridge, with no implication to RH unless an explicit sourced edge says so.

name: Obstruction class
definition: A typed reason that a proposed route is blocked, killed, circular, or incomplete.

name: Research question
definition: A currently open, explicitly sourced reduction or missing bridge.

name: Riemann zeta function ζ(s)
definition: The meromorphic continuation of the Dirichlet series Σn⁻ˢ, with Euler product in Re(s)>1.

name: Riemann xi function ξ(s)
definition: The completed entire zeta function, normalized to satisfy ξ(s)=ξ(1−s).

name: Riemann Hypothesis
definition: The assertion that every nontrivial zero of ζ has real part one half.

name: Critical line
definition: The vertical line Re(s)=1/2 in the critical strip.

name: Critical strip
definition: The strip 0<Re(s)<1 containing the nontrivial zeta zeros.

name: Riemann kernel Φ(u)
definition: The classical even rapidly decaying kernel whose Fourier transform gives Ξ on the critical line.
sources: Titchmarsh, The Theory of the Riemann Zeta-function, §2.16

name: Ξ(t)
definition: The real even function ξ(1/2+it), represented as a Fourier transform of the Riemann kernel.
sources: Titchmarsh, The Theory of the Riemann Zeta-function, §2.16

name: Fourier transform
definition: The integral transform exchanging a function with its frequency representation.

name: Mellin transform
definition: The multiplicative transform M[f](s)=∫₀∞f(x)xˢ⁻¹dx.

name: Laplace transform
definition: The integral transform f↦∫₀∞e⁻ˢᵗf(t)dt.

name: Zeta functional equation
definition: The symmetry relating completed zeta values at s and 1−s.

name: Riemann–Weil explicit formula
definition: A distributional identity relating sums over zeta zeros to prime-power and archimedean terms.

name: von Mangoldt function Λ(n)
definition: The arithmetic weight log p on prime powers pᵏ and zero otherwise.

name: Chebyshev ψ(x)
definition: The summatory function Σn≤x Λ(n).

name: Prime-counting function π(x)
definition: The number of primes not exceeding x.

name: Zero-counting function N(T)
definition: The number of nontrivial zeta zeros with ordinate between zero and T, counted with multiplicity.
sources: Titchmarsh, The Theory of the Riemann Zeta-function, Thm. 9.3

name: Pair correlation of zeta zeros
definition: The limiting local two-point statistic conjectured for normalized zeta ordinates.

name: GUE statistics
definition: The local eigenvalue statistics of large random Hermitian matrices in the unitary symmetry class.

name: Montgomery pair-correlation conjecture
definition: The conjecture that normalized zeta-zero pair correlation agrees with the GUE sine-kernel law.

name: Weil quadratic form Q(f)
definition: The explicit-formula quadratic functional whose positivity on the admissible test class is equivalent to RH.

name: Weil archimedean term
definition: The gamma-factor contribution to the Weil explicit-formula quadratic form.

name: Weil prime term
definition: The prime-power contribution, weighted by the von Mangoldt function, in the Weil form.

name: Weil pole term
definition: The contribution of the pole and trivial normalization terms in the Weil form.

name: Weil positivity criterion
definition: Nonnegativity of the Weil quadratic form on the full admissible test class.

name: Gabor zero side
definition: The zero-side functional evaluated on the corpus pure-Gabor two-parameter test family.

name: Pure Gabor test family
definition: The two-parameter Gaussian wavepacket family indexed by a>0 and frequency ω.

name: Pure-Gabor zero-side criterion
definition: Nonnegativity of the Gabor zero side for every pure-Gabor packet.

name: Rational pure-Gabor criterion
definition: Nonnegativity of the pure-Gabor zero side on positive rational scales and rational frequencies.

name: Gabor prime-side rational criterion
definition: The rational pure-Gabor criterion rewritten using the pole, prime-comb, and archimedean sides.

name: Li coefficients λₙ
definition: Coefficients obtained from derivatives of log ξ at s=1 in Li's criterion.

name: Li criterion
definition: Nonnegativity of all Li coefficients.

name: Nyman–Beurling closure space
definition: The closed span in L²(0,1) of fractional-part combinations satisfying the Nyman–Beurling constraint.
sources: Nyman, Ark. Mat. 1 (1950); Beurling, Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 41 (1955)

name: Nyman–Beurling criterion
definition: The closure criterion for approximating the constant function in L²(0,1).

name: Báez-Duarte criterion
definition: A discrete Nyman–Beurling approximation criterion equivalent to RH.

name: Hardy space H²
definition: The Hilbert space of analytic functions with square-integrable boundary values in the relevant half-plane or disk model.

name: de Bruijn–Newman constant Λ
definition: The threshold heat-flow parameter above which the deformed Riemann Fourier transform has only real zeros.

name: Rodgers–Tao theorem Λ≥0
definition: The theorem that the de Bruijn–Newman constant is nonnegative.

name: Newman heat-flow criterion
definition: The criterion identifying RH with the equality Λ=0, given the classical upper implication and Λ≥0.

name: Laguerre–Pólya class
definition: The class of real entire functions locally approximable by real-rooted polynomials.
sources: Levin, Distribution of Zeros of Entire Functions, Ch. VIII

name: Hermite–Biehler class
definition: Entire functions E satisfying |E(z)|>|E*(z)| in the upper half-plane.
sources: de Branges, Hilbert Spaces of Entire Functions

name: de Branges space
definition: A Hilbert space of entire functions generated by a Hermite–Biehler function.
sources: de Branges, Hilbert Spaces of Entire Functions

name: Lee–Yang property
definition: A zero-location property placing partition-function zeros on a prescribed circle or line after normalization.

name: KPS van Dantzig theorem
definition: A sourced theorem connecting specified characteristic-function pairs and Lee–Yang-type zero geometry; the map records only the corpus-used formulation.

name: van Dantzig pair
definition: A pair of characteristic functions related by reciprocal analytic continuation in the van Dantzig problem.

name: Pólya frequency function
definition: A function whose translation kernel is totally positive of all orders.

name: Toeplitz positivity
definition: Positive semidefiniteness or total positivity conditions on Toeplitz matrices formed from a coefficient sequence.

name: Hankel moment positivity
definition: Positive semidefiniteness of Hankel matrices built from a moment or coefficient sequence.

name: Jensen polynomials
definition: Polynomials built from consecutive Taylor coefficients of an entire function.

name: Jensen polynomial hyperbolicity
definition: Real-rootedness of every Jensen polynomial in the degree and shift range specified by the criterion.

name: GORZ Jensen-polynomial theorem
definition: The theorem that fixed-degree Jensen polynomials associated with ξ are eventually hyperbolic with Hermite asymptotics.

name: Hilbert–Pólya operator
definition: A conjectural self-adjoint operator whose spectrum would encode nontrivial zeta ordinates.
sources: Pólya correspondence, 1912–1914; Hilbert reported by Conrey (2003)

name: Berry–Keating xp Hamiltonian
definition: A semiclassical dilation Hamiltonian proposed as a model for the average zeta-zero counting law.

name: Connes trace formula
definition: A noncommutative-geometric trace-formula approach representing zeta zeros through an absorption spectrum.

name: Adele class space
definition: The quotient of the adele ring by the multiplicative action of the global field.

name: Connes–Consani scaling site
definition: A characteristic-one geometric framework carrying scaling and arithmetic-site structures.

name: Selberg trace formula
definition: An identity relating spectral data of a hyperbolic quotient to lengths of closed geodesics.

name: Modular surface
definition: The finite-area hyperbolic orbifold PSL₂(Z)\H.
sources: Iwaniec, Spectral Methods of Automorphic Forms

name: Eisenstein series
definition: A noncuspidal automorphic eigenfunction formed by summing a height function over a parabolic quotient.
sources: Iwaniec, Spectral Methods of Automorphic Forms

name: Eisenstein constant term
definition: The two-term Fourier coefficient encoding the scattering coefficient of an Eisenstein series.
sources: Iwaniec, Spectral Methods of Automorphic Forms, Ch. 3

name: Epstein zeta function
definition: The zeta function obtained by summing powers of a positive quadratic form over nonzero lattice vectors.

name: Hecke operator
definition: A commuting arithmetic correspondence acting on automorphic forms.

name: Hecke correspondence
definition: An algebraic or adelic correspondence whose induced action gives a Hecke operator.

name: Bruhat–Tits tree of PGL₂(Qₚ)
definition: The regular tree of homothety classes of rank-two Zₚ-lattices.

name: Bost–Connes system
definition: A quantum statistical mechanical system whose partition function is ζ and whose symmetries encode class-field data.

name: Arakelov intersection theory
definition: Intersection theory on arithmetic varieties combining finite-place and archimedean contributions.

name: Arithmetic Hodge index theorem
definition: A negativity theorem for arithmetic intersections orthogonal to a polarization, in the hypotheses of Yuan–Zhang.

name: Deninger cohomological program
definition: A conjectural cohomological and dynamical framework intended to model arithmetic zeta functions by regularized determinants.
sources: Deninger, Proc. ICM Berlin 1998, Doc. Math. Extra Vol. I

name: Weil conjectures over finite fields
definition: The rationality, functional equation, Betti-number interpretation, and Riemann-hypothesis bounds for zeta functions of smooth projective varieties over finite fields.

name: Deligne's function-field RH theorem
definition: The weight theorem proving the Riemann-hypothesis part of the Weil conjectures.

name: Pick function
definition: A holomorphic function mapping the upper half-plane into itself.
sources: Donoghue, Monotone Matrix Functions and Analytic Continuation

name: Herglotz function
definition: A Pick function represented by a positive measure through the Herglotz formula.
sources: Donoghue, Monotone Matrix Functions and Analytic Continuation

name: Bernstein function
definition: A nonnegative smooth function whose derivative is completely monotone.

name: Completely monotone function
definition: A smooth function f on (0,∞) satisfying (−1)ⁿf⁽ⁿ⁾≥0 for every n.

name: Stieltjes function
definition: A function representable as a nonnegative constant plus an integral of 1/(x+t) against a positive measure.

name: Carlson uniqueness theorem
definition: A uniqueness theorem for entire functions of restricted exponential type from values on the nonnegative integers.

name: Saddle-point method
definition: An asymptotic method based on deforming an integral through critical points of its phase.

name: Lambert W function
definition: The multivalued inverse of w↦weʷ.

name: Prolate spheroidal concentration operator
definition: The time–band limiting integral operator whose eigenvalues quantify simultaneous concentration.

name: Landau–Widom concentration asymptotics
definition: Asymptotics for the transition region of eigenvalues of time–frequency concentration operators.

name: Prime torus
definition: The infinite product torus whose coordinates encode prime phases in the Bohr lift of Dirichlet series.

name: Bohr lift
definition: The correspondence sending a Dirichlet series to a power series on a polytorus by prime factorization.

name: Dirichlet series on the polytorus
definition: The analytic function on an infinite polydisk obtained from a Dirichlet series through the Bohr lift.

name: Hypercontractivity on the prime torus
definition: Norm-improving estimates for the prime-torus semigroup acting on Bohr lifts.

name: Beurling–Deny criterion
definition: A criterion characterizing Dirichlet forms by Markovian contraction properties.

name: Positivity-preserving semigroup
definition: A semigroup of operators preserving the positive cone.

name: Cuntz system
definition: Isometries with orthogonal ranges summing to the identity, generating a Cuntz algebra.

name: Unital completely positive map
definition: A unital linear map whose matrix amplifications preserve positivity.
sources: Paulsen, Completely Bounded Maps and Operator Algebras

name: Measured groupoid
definition: A groupoid equipped with measure-class data suitable for convolution and operator-algebra constructions.
sources: Renault, A Groupoid Approach to C*-algebras

name: Groupoid modular function
definition: The Radon–Nikodym cocycle comparing left and right measures on a measured groupoid.
sources: Renault, A Groupoid Approach to C*-algebras

name: Groupoid half-density
definition: A square-root density used to define intrinsic convolution without choosing a unimodular measure.

name: Additive adeles
definition: The restricted product of all completions of Q under addition.

name: Self-dual Haar measure
definition: The Haar measure normalized so Fourier inversion is self-dual for a chosen additive character.

name: Relative determinant
definition: A regularized determinant comparing two operators when their resolvent difference has suitable trace class.

name: Krein spectral shift function
definition: A function encoding trace differences f(A)−f(B) for suitable self-adjoint operator pairs.

name: Vitali–Montel normal-family principle
definition: Local boundedness plus convergence on a uniqueness set yields compactness and analytic convergence in standard normal-family formulations.
sources: Conway, Functions of One Complex Variable I, Ch. VII

name: Euler–Gross entropy gap
definition: A corpus diagnostic comparing arithmetic Euler structure with Gaussian or control-world entropy.

name: Ising/Lee–Yang compiler
definition: A corpus route translating finite interaction data into a Lee–Yang polynomial test.

name: Cusp surgery
definition: A geometric degeneration method relating determinant data before and after cutting or truncating a cusp.

name: Efrat determinant formula
definition: A determinant identity for hyperbolic surfaces with cusps in the cited formulation.

name: Regulator jump
definition: A measured discontinuity or large change in a regulator-like quantity used by the corpus factoring geometry.

name: Murru–Salvatori regulator method
definition: The external regulator/factorization proposal audited by the corpus; it is not an RH mechanism.

name: OpenAI 2026 long-prime-gap work
definition: An external long-prime-gap result tracked by the corpus and explicitly classified as unrelated to RH.

name: Chuk compact-window certificate at L=0.8
definition: The compact-window positivity certificate reproduced by the corpus at L=0.8; it is finite-window evidence, not an RH claim.

name: Cubic wedges of arXiv:2607.16795
definition: The external cubic-wedge construction audited by the corpus without promotion to an RH implication.

name: TFPT axiom c3=1/(8π)
definition: The project compiler's declared c3 normalization.

name: TFPT axiom g_car=5
definition: The project compiler's declared carrier count.

name: D5⊕A3+μ4⇒E8 compiler
definition: The project-internal finite compiler from D5, A3, and μ4 data to E8.

name: E8 lattice
definition: The even unimodular rank-eight lattice as used by the TFPT compiler.
sources: Conway–Sloane, Sphere Packings, Lattices and Groups

name: E8 theta series
definition: The theta series of the E8 lattice, equal to the weight-four Eisenstein series E4.
sources: Serre, A Course in Arithmetic, Ch. VII

name: E8 cascade
definition: The project-internal cascade of finite E8 readouts.

name: CM seam τ=i
definition: The Gaussian complex-multiplication seam used by TFPT arithmetic constructions.

name: Gaussian E8 module
definition: The Gaussian E8 module and Hecke-groupoid data audited in verification v714.

name: Seam geodesic
definition: A project geometric factoring route along the Gaussian seam; classified as unrelated to RH.

name: Gate 0
definition: The corpus name for the initial adelic/groupoid compatibility gate.

name: Plastic-number threshold
definition: A corpus finite threshold involving the real root of x³=x+1.

name: Terminal cross-ratio statement
definition: The open cofinal terminal inequality q_N<1 in the corpus reduction.

name: L* subordination statement
definition: The canonical open subordination inequality for the corpus free-window reduction.

name: λ*(L) ladder
definition: The scale-indexed minimum-margin ladder measured in compact Weil-window experiments.

name: Quadrep
definition: The project finite quadratic representation bridge tracked by the RH corpus.

name: Inner bridges
definition: The corpus family of finite bridges internal to the compiler representation.

name: Outer bridges
definition: The corpus family of finite bridges from compiler data toward external analytic objects.

name: Relay lead law
definition: A measured prime-event-log relation in the corpus; no RH implication is asserted.

name: Narrowband Weil probe
definition: A finite-window Weil-form experiment restricted to narrow frequency bands.

name: Archimedean rate identity
definition: The corpus-isolated archimedean identity and selected-tent O(δ²) rate.

name: Extraction joint
definition: The missing joint transferring finite selected-window positivity to the full Weil test class.

name: Finite Weil window
definition: A finite-dimensional compression of the localized Weil form to a specified window and basis.

name: Selected-window family
definition: The project family of finite test windows used in the formalized extraction chain.

name: Renamed RH-equivalent / circularity
definition: A route assumes RH or a known equivalent under another name.

name: Prime-phase coherence
definition: The missing control of correlated prime phases needed by several finite-to-global routes.

name: p=2 defect
definition: A structural obstruction in the first 2-adic Weil channel.

name: Pole mode uncontrolled
definition: Failure to control the pole contribution uniformly in the proposed positivity transfer.

name: Archimedean compensation
definition: A mismatch where the archimedean channel compensates or reverses a prime-side sign.

name: Unimodularity / no half-density
definition: The groupoid construction lacks the half-density or modular correction needed for intrinsic convolution.

name: Zero-bearing denominator
definition: A proposed quotient places zeta zeros in its denominator, creating poles or circular sign information.

name: Finite-window ceiling / Landau–Widom decay
definition: Concentration eigenvalue decay prevents a fixed compact window from controlling the full test class.

name: Pick-sign violation
definition: The candidate continuation violates the upper-half-plane sign required of a Pick function.

name: Non-real cofactor zeros
definition: A Mellin cofactor has non-real zeros incompatible with the proposed Lee–Yang or Pick class.

name: World blindness
definition: The route does not distinguish arithmetic MAIN data from control worlds.

name: Lossy constant
definition: An inequality loses the quantitative margin required by the next reduction.

name: Structural mismatch
definition: The route identifies objects that are not mathematically the same object.

name: No bridge
definition: The construction has no sourced dictionary to an RH-adjacent criterion.

name: Gabor positivity for the specific window class
definition: Does the corpus pure-Gabor zero-side remain nonnegative on the stated two-parameter window family?

name: Global all-place intersection identity
definition: Can finite-place and archimedean geometric contributions be assembled into the exact global identity required by the route?

name: Exact relative determinant identity
definition: Can the proposed relative determinant be identified exactly with the target explicit-formula object?

name: Independent positivity source
definition: Is there a positivity mechanism independent of merely rewriting the explicit formula or an RH-equivalent criterion?

name: Scale law of λ*(L)
definition: What is the rigorous scale dependence of the compact-window margin λ*(L)?

name: Prime-phase coherence control
definition: Can the correlated prime phases be controlled with a non-world-blind estimate?

name: Half-density from geometry
definition: Does the proposed groupoid geometry canonically supply the required half-density and modular correction?

name: Static prime event log
definition: The family of static coefficient sequences in the corpus: E8 shell counts, Gaussian signed census, Hecke coefficients, and the von Mangoldt comb. It is not an autonomous dynamics.

name: Finite-clock commensurability
definition: Finite-order clocks have commensurable periods and therefore cannot realize more than one primitive period proportional to log p.

name: Autonomous prime generator
definition: Whether a source-only non-periodic TFPT evolution derived from the compiler emits support log(p^k) and von Mangoldt amplitudes without sieve, prime table, or fitted event locations.

name: Weight-4 to GL(1) transport
definition: The open canonical transport from the E4/f8 lattice-Hecke world to the GL(1) xi/Weil world, including the archimedean place.

name: Waldspurger square positivity
definition: Positivity of central f8 twist values represented by squares of half-integral Fourier coefficients, independent of the zeta explicit formula.

name: Siegel–Weil positive linear carrier
definition: The positive measure Theta(d)|d|^{-a} whose prime side is a plus combination of shifted zeta forms; certified only in the Euler region.

name: E8 Eisenstein RH-neutrality
definition: The E8 theta L-function is zeta(s)zeta(s-3), so its nontrivial zeros are exactly the zeta zeros and their translate; the bridge renames rather than locates them.

name: Positive-cone blindness
definition: A certificate whose premises retain only the positive measure, negative support, window degree, and nonnegative source terms is invariant under scaling the negative mass, so it cannot certify a signed moment inequality; a metric comparison is necessary.

name: Rankin–Selberg norm-square
definition: The Rankin–Selberg diagonal GNS/norm-square positivity on automorphic forms; it does not by itself control the signed Weil defect.

name: Cohen positive seeds L(E4⊗χ_d,2)
definition: Cohen–Eisenstein edge values L(E4⊗χ_d,2) and L(−1,χ_d) used as positive seeds; a centre version is GRH(χ_d).

name: SOS / Pontryagin language
definition: The sum-of-squares / Pontryagin-split language for the signed moment form; it exists exactly when the negative register is empty.

name: Kasteleyn orientation language
definition: Value-preserving Kasteleyn/orientation language on the Cauchy–Binet configuration space, available exactly in the positive-measure class.

name: Hamiltonian PSD language
definition: Canonical Hamiltonian positivity as a signed-moment pivot condition, not an independent positivity source.

name: Dual-pair product language
definition: The exact dual-pair product law that synchronizes signs and contributes no second positivity condition.

name: Connes–Meyer adele-class scaling flow
definition: The idele-class scaling representation in which prime powers contribute periodic-orbit terms of length log p to an explicit-formula trace.

name: Bost–Connes KMS system
definition: An arithmetic C*-dynamical system whose partition function is zeta(beta), with a phase transition at beta=1 and Hecke-semigroup prime generators.

name: Primon or Riemann gas
definition: A quantum gas with one-particle energies log p, so the bosonic partition function is zeta(beta); the prime spectrum is input rather than derived.

name: Berry–Keating dilation Hamiltonian
definition: The xp dilation generator with semiclassical zero-count asymptotics; a canonical self-adjoint boundary condition encoding prime oscillations remains missing.

name: Deninger foliated dynamics
definition: A conjectural arithmetic flow whose closed prime orbits and Lefschetz trace model the explicit formula, with a Hodge-type positivity requirement.

name: Knauf arithmetic quantum statistical system
definition: A family of spin-chain and arithmetic statistical systems encoding factorisation through Hamiltonians, partition functions, KMS phases, and entropy.

name: Event-log function
aliases: dynamical function of the prime event log
definition: Whether a canonical TFPT evolution derives the prime event log as an energy spectrum, primitive-orbit length spectrum, or scale-flow trace without importing arithmetic.

name: Unitarity of emergent TFPT time
definition: Whether emergent TFPT time has a canonical positive Hilbert metric and self-adjoint generator that can be transported to an arithmetic scale flow; no such general axiom was found.

name: Edge L-values
definition: L-values on the edge of the Euler/absolute-convergence region, as opposed to central critical values.

name: Edge nonvanishing method
definition: Classical nonvanishing methods such as ζ(1+it)≠0 used as comparison templates, without an RH implication.

name: Quarter-shift to centre
definition: The plus-balance of the Siegel–Weil carrier sits off the critical line by a quarter-shift, so Euler-region positivity is not the Weil criterion at the centre.

name: Farkas witness n≡6 mod 8
definition: A Farkas/LP witness on atoms n≡6 mod 8 showing the residual λ* gap of the theta-library hull is not removed by a finite deterministic-sign family.

name: Metric-by-operator positivity
definition: A template in which positivity is an output of a self-adjoint or trace-class operator rather than a signed-measure comparison.

name: RHP/IIKS/Toda tau framework
definition: The Riemann–Hilbert / IIKS / Toda-tau dictionary for the finite wall determinant, certified in v955–v963 as finite identities with cofinal no-pole still open.

name: Suzuki screw functions / canonical systems
definition: Suzuki screw functions and the associated canonical/de Branges systems used as a W1 identification of the TFPT atom measure.

name: Quillen/BFK seam determinants
definition: Quillen metrics and Burghelea–Friedlander–Kappeler gluing determinants for elliptic operators on seamed or cut manifolds.

name: I5 transport-ledger criterion
definition: The coupled prime–archimedean inequality I5 left after the transport ledger closes; typed as equivalent to Weil positivity, not as a reduction.

name: R† kernel–Loewner positivity stack
definition: The R† kernel–Loewner positivity stack at compact windows, certified numerically in v1017 with a float64 floor, not an interval [E] certificate.

name: Multiplicative composition necessity
definition: A monotone additive information function on multiplicatively composed positive-integer labels is c log n; primes are the free monoid's irreducible generators.

name: E8 census quantum statistical system
definition: The arithmetic state census with partition function sum sigma_3(n)n^-beta=zeta(beta)zeta(beta-3) and Hecke norm-labelled generators.

name: Seam modular clock
definition: The free modular Hamiltonian K=log((1-C)C^-1) reconstructed from a reflection-positive seam covariance.

name: Resummed clock tower
definition: The family of spectra 6 log(N/(N-n)); its all-N union is 6 log of the positive rational numbers with noncanonical label multiplicity.

name: Koide Möbius flow
definition: The autonomous Riccati flow with fixed points 2 and 5 and time-one multipliers 64/729 and 729/64.

name: Four-dimensional lattice dynamics contract
definition: A local Hermitian Hamiltonian family with transfer exp(-aH), quasilocal thermodynamic dynamics, and a Lieb-Robinson bound.

name: QCA unitary dilation
definition: The strictly local collision-band unitary dilation whose reduced diagonal dynamics is the seam Markov transfer B^n.

name: No canonical integer state label
definition: The physical clock and lattice constructions do not derive a multiplicative positive-integer label whose norm supplies a log-integer spectrum.

name: Archimedean place of Q
definition: The real completion whose local zeta integral supplies the Gamma factor and log pi; for exp(2 pi i x), exp(-pi x^2) and Lebesgue measure are Fourier self-dual.

name: Class-number formula for Q(i)
definition: For Q(i), the Dirichlet class-number formula gives L(1,chi_-4)=2 pi h/(w sqrt(|d|))=pi/4 because h=1, d=-4 and w=|mu4|=4.
sources: Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory, Chapter VII

name: Finite-infinite place balance
definition: The Guinand-Weil explicit formula is an identity balancing von Mangoldt prime-power data at finite places against the real-place Gamma, log pi and pole terms.

name: Archimedean dominance criterion
definition: Nonnegativity of the full Weil form: the archimedean-plus-pole contribution dominates the prime contribution for every admissible test function; equivalent to RH on the full class.

name: c3 and L(1,chi_-4) numerology
definition: The algebraic rewrite c3=1/(8 pi)=1/(32 L(1,chi_-4)) has no corpus derivation connecting P1 to the Gaussian class-number formula and is firewall-flagged as coincidence.

name: TFPT mu4 mark
definition: The four-element mark/unit structure carried by the TFPT boundary and E8 glue.

name: chi-minus-4 signed census
definition: The corpus exact finite split of prime residue classes by the real character chi_-4; it does not itself evaluate the Euler product at s=1.

name: Census QSM norm flow
definition: The single-module rank-four Gaussian submodule QSM with endomorphism-semigroup isometries, index Hamiltonian, and classical Solomon-zeta partition function; it constructs bridge 1 only.

name: Connes–Marcolli GLn arithmetic QSM
definition: The classical higher-rank arithmetic quantum statistical system built from commensurability classes, determinant-norm time evolution, and KMS states.

name: Index-flow time evolution
definition: The dynamics sigma_t(mu_A)=Norm(det A)^(it)mu_A generated by the logarithm of submodule index on the canonical submodule Hilbert space.

name: P1 Gauss–Bonnet positive normalization
definition: The exact positive scalar c3=1/(8pi) obtained from the one-sided S2 curvature integral; this is a coefficient, not a positive arithmetic quadratic form.

name: E8 positive lattice norm
definition: The positive-definite even unimodular E8 Gram form whose shell counts are 240 sigma_3(n).

name: Seam OS positive transfer
definition: The reflection-positive Gaussian reconstruction Lambda=e^{-h}, a positive contraction on the seam GNS space.

name: Seam modular generator

name: Markov QCA unitary dilation
definition: The exact Stinespring collision dilation on a qutrit system and record-qutrit stream whose reduced populations follow the TFPT Markov transfer.

name: Quasilocal Hamiltonian dynamics
definition: Hamiltonian-class thermodynamic dynamics with Hermitian local H, positive Euclidean transfer, unitary tau_t, and a Lieb-Robinson bound.

name: E8 theta heat operator
definition: The positive heat semigroup on L2(R8/E8), whose trace is E4 and whose spectral zeta is 240(8pi^2)^(-s)zeta(s)zeta(s-3).

name: Hodge and Riemann-bilinear positivity candidate
definition: Finite Hodge data and a conditional Riemann-bilinear route on the mu3-cover; no Kahler positivity theorem is established specifically at the tau=i E8 seam.

name: Perron fixed-point transport
definition: The finite primitive stochastic transport with unique positive attractor and spectrum {1,(2/3)^6,(1/3)^6}.

name: Seam KMS and Gibbs positivity
definition: Positive thermal states and Boltzmann weights on seam and Hamiltonian-class algebras.

name: Heat and spectral-zeta regularization
definition: Positive heat semigroups on compact models together with meromorphically continued spectral zeta determinants and Seeley-DeWitt coefficients.

name: Horizon replica and area-law positivity
definition: Finite Gaussian, determinant, entropy, and gapped area-law structures used to pin local horizon coefficients.

name: Seam RP blindness and straddle selector
definition: Free RP and kinematic forms are side-blind, while a fenced interacting toy selects one seam-bit member with positive coupling and OS/GNS form.

name: Admissible OS positive measure
definition: The admissible-sector PSD transfer, tight measure family, and many-body Hamiltonian H_OS=-log T with inherited finite-model gap.

name: Finite Weil GNS family metric
definition: Finite character-family GNS forms combining prime and archimedean channels but not identified with the global central-line Weil form.

name: Matching-ledger per-term positivity
definition: Finite-window decomposition of the Weil ledger into certified, archimedean, and correction terms; global positivity remains open.

name: Discrete-spectrum neutrality
definition: For compact finite-type operators, arithmetic L-functions arise as spectral zeta functions; their analytically continued zeros are not eigenvalues of the positive operator.

name: No archimedean-prime joint space
definition: TFPT has archimedean positive operator spaces and static prime/Hecke spaces, but no canonical Hilbert space carrying both a multiplicative arithmetic action and the physical self-adjoint flow.

name: Finite-family target mismatch
definition: A positive metric on sampled character families does not transfer to the global zeta Weil form without an independently proved representation and limit theorem.

name: Marked Kneser neighbour groupoid
definition: The marked Kneser-neighbour groupoid of mu4 glue states; fibre ratios were identically one, so no half-density amplitude.

name: HNF submodule correspondence groupoid
definition: The degree-graded HNF submodule correspondence groupoid of the rank-4 Gaussian module; source and target HNF fibres agree, so Delta is identically one.

name: Euler-side blindness
definition: Every positivity built on a compact torus, finite-type module, or discrete spectrum is the Euler side of a would-be reflection-positive scale model; per-term positive implies blind, and the critical side is the criterion.

name: Stochastic scale semigroup on Connes cokernel
definition: The only admissible shape of bridge 2: a manifestly positive Markov semigroup in log-scale on the adele class space modulo the Fourier-invariant part whose generator carries the zeros.

name: RH as reflection positivity
definition: RH is equivalent to Bochner positivity of the Weil kernel, to OS reflection positivity of the Wick-rotated kernel under the functional-equation reflection, and to Hilbert–Pólya.
sources: Widder, The Laplace Transform; Bernstein theorem

name: E8 sublattice RG semigroup
definition: Conditional expectations onto superlattice-periodic functions on R^8/E8, with RG time the log index, reflection L to L-star, and Solomon scale two-point function zeta(s) through zeta(s-7).

name: Hecke covering-index theorem
definition: For an injective integral endomorphism A of the E8 torus, pullback on C(R^8/E8) has finite covering index |det A| and multiplicative composition. Proved here exactly, but mathematically classical and only an arithmetic-side stand-in.

name: Pimsner-Popa index entropy
definition: For a finite covering conditional expectation, log Ind is the additive logarithmic index quantity; this does not by itself make log Ind a physical modular Hamiltonian.
sources: Pimsner-Popa, Entropy and index for subfactors, Ann. Sci. ENS 19 (1986)
Watatani, Index for C*-subalgebras, Memoirs AMS 83 (1990)

name: Cuntz-Laca semigroup algebra
definition: A classical semigroup crossed-product arithmetic QSM in which isometries carry a norm-defined time evolution. It realizes the desired algebra only after the index dynamics is specified, not derived from TFPT physics.
sources: Laca-Raeburn, J. London Math. Soc. 59 (1999), DOI:10.1112/S0024610798006620

name: Connes trace-formula dichotomy
definition: Cutoff positivity before quotienting is vacuous because of a divergent positive boundary term; the Fourier-invariant cokernel version is criterion-bearing. Compact-torus counting diverges as Lambda^8, not as the adelic log Lambda term.

name: Physical index-modular state
definition: Does the physical 4D OS sector algebra admit a state whose own modular flow acts on lattice-endomorphism sectors with modular Hamiltonian log index, rather than assuming the index dynamics?

name: Torus-cutoff equality hunt
definition: The search for a compact-torus or heat-kernel identification of the Weil Arch-Prime-Pole remainder; compact-torus traces diverge as Lambda^8, not as the adelic log Lambda term.

name: Suzuki screw-function criterion
definition: For Suzuki's explicit g, positivity of K_g(t,u)=g(t-u)-g(t)-g(-u)+g(0) on the real line is equivalent to Weil positivity and RH.

name: Zeta canonical-system Hamiltonian
definition: The positive Hamiltonian produced abstractly when the zeta screw kernel is positive; constructing it globally and independently from the prime/archimedean data is the forward problem.

name: Schoenberg-Krein helical embedding
definition: A positive screw kernel is the Gram kernel of stationary increments x(t)-x(0), with squared norm -2g(t); conversely such an embedding gives kernel positivity.

name: de Branges shift positivity
definition: The shift-form condition Re<F,F(.+i)> > 0 is sufficient for critical-line zeros, but Conrey-Li prove that it fails for the natural xi-associated de Branges space; it is strictly stronger than RH.

name: Burnol conductor operator
definition: The local Fourier-invariant operator log|x|+F^-1 log|y| F explaining local explicit-formula terms; its self-adjoint structure does not make the global zeta zeros its point spectrum.

name: Rigorous verified-zero height
definition: Every nontrivial zeta zero with 0 < gamma <= 3000175332800 lies on the critical line.

name: Compact-window finite-height barrier
definition: Compact log-support makes the Fourier transform entire rather than height-supported, so zeros verified through any finite H do not by themselves imply positivity on the whole compact-support function class; a uniform tail/operator bound is additionally required.

name: W2 form-density and limit bridge
definition: Establish the required form-density, Mosco/norm-resolvent and pointwise frame estimates connecting nested TFPT Galerkin spaces to Suzuki's localized form domain.

name: W3 uniform window positivity
definition: Prove positivity uniformly over all windows/scales; finite deployed windows are off-line-zero detectors, while the uniform statement is the conjectural wall.

name: W4 global Weil-positivity transfer
definition: Transfer finite Galerkin/window positivity to the full Weil test-function class using domain density, scale control and uniform estimates.

name: Selected archimedean quadratic-rate statement
definition: Named Lean statement that selected-path archimedean error is O(Delta^2) with a fixed explicit constant. The fixed-constant form is falsified (8.0283 > 4.126 in the small-support regime); the Exists-C form remains open.

name: Selected arch weighted interpolation estimate
definition: Classical weighted interpolation estimate for the productionArchLag near and far integrals; the remaining plumbing for the existential selected-path archimedean O(Delta^2) rate.

name: FREQ cone theorem
definition: The FREQ cone theorem: for arbitrarily large K there exist k>=K and a faithful mu-orthonormal transcription of the selected real window with R-dagger(W_k^R)-I/2 positive semidefinite.

name: Selected polynomial approximates grid
definition: Named outer bridge: a coefficient vector z exists so the fullRead versus A_cap quadratic form differs by at most the archimedean error. Contains the channel-positivity bridge; r473 NO_BRIDGE.
